overview: A Kish Island sea-conditions dashboard that shows live marine and weather data for four monitored beaches, with a neon island map, beach comparison, community reports and an admin area.
features: Live water temperature, wave height, wind speed and UV index for Kish Island beaches
Four monitored beaches seeded and shown on an interactive neon island map
Swimming suitability and activity rankings with explained statuses
Admin area to manage beaches, review reports and publish warnings
English and Persian with full right-to-left support
